module: Flowgraph node 'Accumulator' (repeat_instant category). Adds the value of the 'value' pin (1 by default) to an internal sum every frame the 'add' pin has flow; 'reset' resets the sum to data.resetValue (0). Outputs: 'result' (sum) and impulse 'changed'.
notes: The description of the reset pin says it 'has priority over add', but if both are active the value is first reset to zero then incremented.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (created by _flowgraph_createNode(C)). The methods are called by the flowgraph manager or the editor.

_executionStarted.desc: Resets the sum to resetValue and updates result.

_executionStopped.desc: Resets the sum to resetValue and updates result.

work.desc: Applies reset, then adds value if add is active (changed=true), writes result.
